text: Astronomers employ advanced telescopes to explore the universe and its myriad marvels. These instruments enable us to scrutinize distant objects, including nebulae, which are expansive interstellar clouds of gas and dust. Nebulae frequently serve as the primordial sites where new stars are born. By analyzing the light emanating from these nebulae, scientists can gather insights into the prevailing conditions and materials present in the universe billions of years ago. This information provides valuable knowledge about the formation and evolution of stars and galaxies.
